sources.entry: Cellar - Homebrew manager for formulae, casks, and services that previews what brew will change before it runs.

summary.one_liner: Cellar is a native macOS app that gives a graphical interface to Homebrew for upgrading, installing, cleaning up, and running services, with previews of what brew will change before it runs.
keywords: start and stop background services mac
summary.what_it_does: Cellar lets you browse installed Homebrew formulae and casks, search Homebrew, and install, upgrade, pin, or uninstall packages individually or in batches. Before running Upgrade All, Clean Up, or dependency removal, it previews the packages, dependencies, and download sizes involved. A Services section starts, stops, restarts, or runs services once, showing CPU, memory, ports, uptime, and logs. Environment tools manage per-project Brewfiles, taps, and an interactive dependency graph. Maintenance covers Clean Up, Health Check (brew doctor), disk usage, and scheduled cleanups and checks. The README also describes an Activity log, Quick Open (⌘K), menu bar and widgets, Spotlight indexing, a cellar CLI, and cellar:// deep links.
use_cases: manage Homebrew packages on a Mac without the terminal
preview what brew upgrade or cleanup will remove before running it
start, stop, and monitor Homebrew background services
keep a per-project Brewfile and install missing packages
find and remove unused Homebrew dependencies
free disk space taken by old Homebrew versions and downloads
check Homebrew health with brew doctor
how_to_run: Or download the latest .dmg from Releases, open it, and drag Cellar to Applications
git clone https://github.com/tuhage/Cellar (URL was blank in the README; assumed from the repository name)
notable: Previews every change (packages, dependencies, download size) before Upgrade All, Clean Up, or removals run
Recognizes common failures such as outdated Command Line Tools, a full disk, no internet, or a cask app installed outside Homebrew, and offers a fix button
Per-project Brewfiles with an 'Open in Cellar' Finder action
Command-line tool (cellar status, start, list, search, health, cleanup) and cellar:// deep links
No account or telemetry; talks to the local brew installation
caveats: Requires macOS 15 or later and Homebrew
Installation via the .dmg uses in-app updates; Homebrew installs update through brew upgrade instead
The README does not state a paid tier or any platform beyond macOS
